tasks.description: Verify the configured Supabase default secret for the existing first-aid photo maintenance endpoint.
constraints: Independent Review and QA. Local gates only. Controller owns narat-staging and usage limits.
Preserve the legacy Bearer path. Accept only the configured Supabase default secret via apikey. Reject publishable, unknown and named keys.
Do not change SQL, retention, 024, StoreKit, or the scoped deletion rules.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production entrypoints type-check and exact diff is clean.
Fixtures preserve legacy and scoped cleanup, accept the configured default secret on apikey, and reject unauthorized requests before Storage or SQL.
